decisions.reason: Height-adjustable executive desks suit the post-pandemic demand for flexible and representative workplaces, so this multi-model line has growing option value at modest holding cost.
The carpet floor cushions are a niche accessory, but they reuse rug materials and cost little to keep, so the option stays open despite having been unobserved since 2018.
The sofa was only weakly emphasized and has gone unobserved, which raises the chance of withdrawal, but it is close to the core upholstery business and cheap to hold while evidence accumulates.
The rug collection is a strategic flagship that anchors the firm's interiors direction and supports the cushion line, so this growth option is worth keeping open despite its distance from the core.
